//go:build integration

package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

const t18DiagnosticSubject = "student.diagnostic-result.committed.v1"

func t18DiagnosticPool(t *testing.T) *pgxpool.Pool {
	t.Helper()
	dsn := os.Getenv("STUDENT_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
	if dsn == "" {
		t.Skip("requires explicitly owned T18 Student PostgreSQL proof database")
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(dsn)
	owned := os.Getenv("T18_OWNED_STUDENT_DATABASE_NAME")
	if err != nil || owned == "" || !strings.HasSuffix(owned, "_integration_proof") || u.Path != "/"+owned || (u.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" && u.Hostname() != "localhost" && u.Hostname() != "::1") {
		t.Fatal("refusing database without exact owned loopback proof identity")
	}
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(context.Background(), dsn)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(pool.Close)
	if err := pool.Ping(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return pool
}

func t18DiagnosticFixture(t *testing.T, pool *pgxpool.Pool) (*DiagnosticAssessmentRepoPG, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentCompleteCommand) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 0, 0, 0, 123456000, time.UTC)
	plan := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{
		Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchema, ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: uuid.NewString(), CourseID: uuid.NewString(),
		PlanRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy, OnboardingVersion: 1,
		BootstrapPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicy, BootstrapContextDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64),
		CourseContentRevision: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64), CreatedAt: now,
	}
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		plan.Assessments = append(plan.Assessments, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem{
			LessonID: uuid.NewString(), TaskID: uuid.NewString(), TaskVersion: 1, UpdatedAt: now, LessonOrder: i, TaskOrder: i,
			LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}},
		})
	}
	var err error
	plan.PlanDigest, err = domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanDigest(plan)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO student_onboarding(student_id,direction_code,self_assessed_experience,desired_stacks,goal_code,preferred_language,weekly_minutes,preferred_pace,profile_version,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES($1,'backend','beginner',ARRAY['go'],'job','en',60,'steady','student-onboarding.v1',1,$2,$2)`, plan.StudentID, now); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("seed owned onboarding: %v", err)
	}
	repo := &DiagnosticAssessmentRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	hash := "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("d", 64)
	attempt, replay, err := repo.ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentReserveCommand{Plan: plan, RequestID: plan.ID, RequestHash: hash, OccurredAt: now})
	if err != nil || replay || attempt.ID != plan.ID {
		t.Fatalf("real reservation: replay=%t err=%v", replay, err)
	}
	for i, item := range plan.Assessments {
		_, replay, err = repo.SubmitDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentSubmitCommand{StudentID: plan.StudentID, AttemptID: plan.ID, TaskID: item.TaskID, RequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: hash, Response: json.RawMessage(`{"selected_options":["option-a"]}`), Correct: i < 2, OccurredAt: now.Add(time.Duration(i+1) * time.Second)})
		if err != nil || replay {
			t.Fatalf("real submit %d: replay=%t err=%v", i, replay, err)
		}
	}
	return repo, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentCompleteCommand{StudentID: plan.StudentID, AttemptID: plan.ID, RequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: hash, OccurredAt: now.Add(4*time.Second + 789*time.Nanosecond)}
}

func TestT18DiagnosticCompletionDurableOutbox(t *testing.T) {
	pool := t18DiagnosticPool(t)
	repo, command := t18DiagnosticFixture(t, pool)
	ctx := context.Background()
	result, replay, err := repo.CompleteDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, command)
	if err != nil || replay {
		t.Fatalf("real completion: replay=%t err=%v", replay, err)
	}
	stored, err := repo.GetDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, command.StudentID, command.AttemptID)
	if err != nil || stored.Result == nil || stored.Result.ResultDigest != result.ResultDigest {
		t.Fatalf("completion must first prove real durable result: err=%v", err)
	}
	var receipts, events int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM student_diagnostic_assessment_receipt WHERE request_id=$1 AND command_kind='COMPLETE'`, command.RequestID).Scan(&receipts); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE subject=$1 AND correlation_id=$2`, t18DiagnosticSubject, command.AttemptID).Scan(&events); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("real PostgreSQL completion: durable_result=true completion_receipts=%d diagnostic_outbox=%d", receipts, events)
	if receipts != 1 || events != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("completion requires one atomic durable trigger: result committed, receipts=%d outbox=%d", receipts, events)
	}
	var unrelated int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM student_target_mastery WHERE student_id=$1)+(SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_evidence WHERE student_id=$1)+(SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_path WHERE student_id=$1)+(SELECT count(*) FROM student_task_answer WHERE student_id=$1)+(SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_action WHERE student_id=$1)`, command.StudentID).Scan(&unrelated); err != nil || unrelated != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("diagnostic completion wrote unrelated learning state: rows=%d err=%v", unrelated, err)
	}
	var payload []byte
	var occurred time.Time
	var eventID, causation string
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT event_id::text,causation_id,occurred_at,payload FROM student_outbox WHERE subject=$1 AND correlation_id=$2`, t18DiagnosticSubject, command.AttemptID).Scan(&eventID, &causation, &occurred, &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	event := domain.IntegrationEvent{EventID: eventID, Subject: t18DiagnosticSubject, CorrelationID: command.AttemptID, CausationID: causation, StudentID: command.StudentID, OccurredAt: occurred, SchemaVersion: 1, Payload: payload}
	if err := domain.ValidateDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(event); err != nil || causation != command.RequestID || !occurred.Equal(result.CompletedAt) {
		t.Fatalf("stored trigger binding: %v", err)
	}
	var envelope domain.EventEnvelope
	var data domain.DiagnosticResultCommittedData
	if json.Unmarshal(payload, &envelope) != nil || json.Unmarshal(envelope.Data, &data) != nil || data.PlanDigest != result.PlanDigest || data.ResultDigest != result.ResultDigest || data.PlanRevision != result.PlanRevision {
		t.Fatal("stored references differ from authoritative result")
	}
	command.OccurredAt = command.OccurredAt.Add(time.Hour)
	duplicate, replay, err := repo.CompleteDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, command)
	if err != nil || !replay || duplicate.ResultDigest != result.ResultDigest || !duplicate.CompletedAt.Equal(result.CompletedAt) {
		t.Fatalf("exact receipt replay: replay=%t err=%v", replay, err)
	}
	var after []byte
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT payload FROM student_outbox WHERE event_id=$1`, eventID).Scan(&after); err != nil || string(after) != string(payload) {
		t.Fatal("replay changed durable trigger")
	}
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE subject=$1 AND correlation_id=$2`, t18DiagnosticSubject, command.AttemptID).Scan(&events); err != nil || events != 1 {
		t.Fatal("replay duplicated durable trigger")
	}
	t.Log("exact completion replay preserved one result, one receipt and one identical trigger")
}

func TestT18DiagnosticOutboxInsertFailureRollsBackCompletion(t *testing.T) {
	pool := t18DiagnosticPool(t)
	repo, command := t18DiagnosticFixture(t, pool)
	ctx := context.Background()
	// A scoped failure injector in the owned proof database rejects only this
	// fixture. NOT VALID avoids scanning existing rows; no schema migration or
	// existing diagnostic result is rewritten or deleted.
	constraint := "t18_outbox_failure_" + strings.ReplaceAll(command.AttemptID, "-", "")
	statement := fmt.Sprintf(`ALTER TABLE student_outbox ADD CONSTRAINT %s CHECK (subject <> '%s' OR correlation_id <> '%s') NOT VALID`, constraint, t18DiagnosticSubject, command.AttemptID)
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, statement); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	drop := "ALTER TABLE student_outbox DROP CONSTRAINT " + constraint
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, "ALTER TABLE student_outbox DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS "+constraint); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("remove scoped failure injector: %v", err)
		}
	})
	if _, _, err := repo.CompleteDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, command); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("outbox insertion failure must fail completion")
	}
	var results, receipts, events int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM student_diagnostic_assessment_result WHERE attempt_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_diagnostic_assessment_receipt WHERE request_id=$2),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE subject=$3 AND correlation_id=$4)`, command.AttemptID, command.RequestID, t18DiagnosticSubject, command.AttemptID).Scan(&results, &receipts, &events); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if results != 0 || receipts != 0 || events != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("failed insertion leaked state: results=%d receipts=%d events=%d", results, receipts, events)
	}
	t.Log("actual outbox insert failure rolled back result and completion receipt")
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, drop); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, replay, err := repo.CompleteDiagnosticAssessment(ctx, command); err != nil || replay {
		t.Fatalf("retry after rollback: replay=%t err=%v", replay, err)
	}
}
